ordered_steps.title: Audit translator schema drift and remove legacy parser shim
ordered_steps.summary: Identify and document schema drift in the translator that is currently masked by the legacy parser shim. Remove the shim only after drift is understood and the schema is corrected.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Schema drift audit report and shim removal patch

ordered_steps.title: Backfill dependency-graph fixtures
ordered_steps.summary: Update dependency-graph fixtures to reflect the new step-id schema. This ensures the plan contract test catches ordering regressions when new step ids are introduced.

ordered_steps.title: Enable translated release-plan dashboard summary behind kill switch
ordered_steps.summary: Enable the user-visible dashboard summary behind a kill switch after schema is stable and fixtures are in place. This prevents rendering incorrect order data.
ordered_steps.bounded_deliverable: Dashboard summary feature flag enabled in canary

ordered_steps.title: Update operator runbook and launch checklist
ordered_steps.summary: Update operational runbook and launch checklist with rollout and rollback procedures once the summary path is proven in canary.

dependency_notes.reason: Schema drift must be audited and shim removed before fixtures can correctly reflect the new step-id schema
Dashboard summary must not ship until dependency-graph fixtures reflect the new schema to prevent incorrect rendering
Runbook requires known rollout and rollback shape, which is only established after dashboard summary is proven in canary

primary_risk.statement: Dashboard renders incorrect step ordering to users if translator schema drift is not fixed before enabling the summary
mitigations: Complete schema drift audit (RN-101) before any dashboard work
Backfill fixtures (RN-102) to ensure plan contract catches ordering issues
Use kill switch for dashboard (RN-103) to allow quick rollback if issues arise

assumption_ledger.note: Extent and locations of schema drift not yet known until RN-101 audit completes
RN-103 specifies kill switch exists for dashboard summary
Canary-only coverage exists but may not be sufficient for dashboard summary validation
